description: An S-4 logistics officer must approve the receiving disposition for three supply lots at a forward operating base, recording any hold, quarantine, priority-issue, and verification actions required before the lots enter routine distribution.

shared_context.S1: Three supply lots arrived at the forward operating base receiving warehouse: Lot R contains vehicle-maintenance consumables, Lot M contains temperature-sensitive medical consumables, and Lot C contains rechargeable communications batteries.
shared_context.S2: Maj. Rivera has final authority to release, hold, or quarantine the lots and to set any distribution priority.
shared_context.S3: The normal receiving process requires a count check, condition check, and destination confirmation before a lot is released to a using section.
shared_context.S4: At the daily receiving huddle, Maj. Rivera reviews each arriving lot with the warehouse, medical logistics, and signal maintenance representatives before signing the distribution disposition.
shared_context.S5: Each representative must make a formal huddle entry for any exception, discrepancy, or directive affecting a lot before Maj. Rivera signs the disposition; the signal maintenance representative must use the formal directive-reporting entry for any higher-headquarters requirement.

PF1.text: SFC Morgan's count of Lot R found 18 fewer cases than the packing list specifies; the discrepancy was confirmed during the morning recount but has not yet been entered on the receiving board.

PF2.text: The temperature logger for Lot M records 42 minutes above the approved 8-degree-Celsius limit; Lt. Patel received the logger printout from the carrier this morning, but the medical quality reviewer has not yet signed the exception record.

PF3.text: A higher-headquarters signal sustainment directive received by WO1 Brooks requires Lot C's battery serial numbers to be issued first to the signal maintenance section and the issue to be completed by 1600 today; the directive is still being entered into the technical supply tracker.

acceptance_conditions: Lot R must be held for recount because its confirmed shortage is 18 cases.
Lot M must be quarantined pending medical quality review, with the 42-minute temperature exception recorded.
Lot C must be released with priority to the signal maintenance section and issued by 1600.
The settlement must include an inventory recount commitment for Lot R.
The settlement must include a medical quality-review commitment for Lot M.
The settlement must include a serial-number verification commitment for Lot C.
The temperature-exception fact must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C6: decisions['lot_C_priority_recipient'] == 'Signal Maintenance' or decisions['lot_C_priority_recipient'] == 'signal maintenance section' or decisions['lot_C_priority_recipient'] == 'Signal Maintenance section'
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'SFC Morgan' and (c['type'] == 'inventory_recount' or c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'follow-up' or c['type'] == 'action') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'Lt. Patel' and (c['type'] == 'medical_quality_review' or c['type'] == 'quality_review' or c['type'] == 'follow-up' or c['type'] == 'action') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['target'] == 'WO1 Brooks' and (c['type'] == 'serial_number_verification' or c['type'] == 'system_entry' or c['type'] == 'documentation' or c['type'] == 'follow-up' or c['type'] == 'action') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 18-case shortage changes Lot R from ordinary release to a hold, sets the variance field to 18 or its shortage encoding of -18, and requires a recount or discrepancy-documentation commitment.

The 42-minute period above the approved temperature limit changes Lot M to a hold or quarantine pending quality review, sets the exception field to 42, and requires a medical quality-review commitment and citation.

The higher-headquarters directive changes Lot C to a release or priority release for the signal maintenance section by 1600 today and requires a commitment documenting the directive or serial-number-tracked issue.
